name: 日晒薄荷
description: Solarized Light 老纸底 #FDF6E3 + 青绿 #2AA198 + 蓝色点缀，sans 无衬线低疲劳长读主题。借鉴 github.com/GordenSun/WX：H1 短粗底线居中、H2 下划、H3 左细条、pre solarized、hr 渐变淡出。适合技术长文/方法拆解/产品深度分析。

styles.h1: font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #073642; text-align: center; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 24px; padding-bottom: 14px;
styles.h2: font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; color: #073642; line-height: 1.45; margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 16px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #2AA198;
styles.h3: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #2AA198; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 12px; padding-left: 10px; border-left: 3px solid #2AA198;
styles.h4: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #073642; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding-left: 8px; border-left: 2px solid #2AA198;
styles.h5: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #586E75; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.55;
styles.h6: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #93A1A1; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.55; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #586E75; line-height: 1.85; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.2px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 4px solid #2AA198; background: #EEE8D5; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 15px; color: #657B83; line-height: 1.8;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 15px; color: #657B83; line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 0.2px; background: transparent;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; display: block; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(7,54,66,0.08); margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 32px; height: 1px; border: none; background: linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#2AA198,transparent);
styles.code: background: #EEE8D5; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 92%; color: #268BD2; font-family: 'SF Mono','JetBrains Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.pre: background: #FDF6E3; border: 1px solid #EEE8D5; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #586E75; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; background: #EEE8D5; color: #586E75; font-size: 12px;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #586E75; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono','JetBrains Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; font-size: 14px;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: #FDF6E3; background: #2AA198; border-bottom: 1px solid #2AA198;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #586E75; line-height: 1.85; letter-spacing: 0.2px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #93A1A1; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
